The two had sworn to escape from everything and spend eternity in paradise.

notes.title: [Release date decided] 3.7 (Fri) 18:00 (GMT+9)
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that the multilingual version of the PC game (Windows/MacOS) "Saihate Station" will be available on Steam from March 7, 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/2db41d654c733c6eb9e07325514de33a7a6bc508.jpg[/img]

The in-game interface is available in Japanese, English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

Volunteer translations have also been made available for Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Thai, and Vietnamese.

This game will be released free to play.

The differences from the existing version include the addition of new languages, new graphics, and a new ending song, so that fans who have already played the game can enjoy the minor changes.

--------------------------------------------------------

[b]⚫︎What is "Saihate Station"?

[/b]

"Saihate Station" is a free PC game released in Japanese only on May 18, 2024.

We successfully raised 2,703,862 yen (achievement rate: 135%) through crowdfunding to create a localized version.

English, Korean, and Simplified Chinese were translated, proofread, and LQAed by "Active Gaming Media Inc." Traditional Chinese was translated and LQAed by freelance game translator "Puchun Hsueh (JUN)."

--------------------------------------------------------

[b]⚫︎Lawson Print & Ministop Print start selling the second wave of bromides (11 types in total)
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/d6b5f96abad3f00ef8eff3959556043ad0d0644d.jpg[/img]

You can print bromides at the multi-copy machines in Lawson and Ministop stores (excluding some stores).

There are 11 designs in total, including original illustrations of everyday life that can't be seen in the game. There are also designs exclusive to Lawson Print and Ministop Print. (Japan only)

The first wave (7 types in total) will continue to be available for purchase.

On sale from 0:00 on Friday, March 7, 2025

--------------------------------------------------------

[b]⚫︎ Paid additional content "Twilight Railway" will also be available on Steam from April 18
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/d5d9a9c902eddfe05be02e6affbb8a236147e715.jpg[/img]

"Saihate Station" additional content is a completely original episode of the same volume as the main story, focusing on "Tatsunami Shion", Haru's friend in spring, summer, and winter.

Control "Tatsunami Shion", who was an assist character in the main story, and travel by train through the abandoned station dyed in the sunset while unraveling their past and searching for true happiness.

It is strongly recommended to play "Saihate Station" in the main story after clearing all routes.

Twilight Railway Trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5WE41t5lvMA
